correctness.rationale: The frozen three-dimensional exact competing-risks map and its physical simplex give stable transverse multipliers E=e^{-nu*tau} and a unit center multiplier on rho=(1+nu)nu*tau/(p(1-E)). Taylor expansion B(a)=ca+da^2+O(a^3) gives c=Lu/m and d=L^2((m+1)e^{-m}-1)/m^2. The exact center coefficient is Q=p d+c alpha(1-p)-pc(1+omega)=v^2D(p)/(p^2u^2). Symbolic independent simplification verifies D(p)=u Psi(p), where Psi is the coefficient polynomial in the published covering result, and D(0)>0, D(1/2)<0, D' <0 give a unique root strictly below 1/2. For Q<0, scalar parabolic iteration and transverse stable foliation give n a_n->-1/Q for sufficiently near physical adopter seeds; for Q>0 the positive center germ repels. Parameter-dependent IFT gives branch a*=-v delta/Q+O(delta^2), attracting for delta>0,Q<0, saddle for delta<0,Q>0. All conclusions local; p=p* is excluded.
